reviews.author: Russ Z
reviews.text: Be cautious with this business. Their initial estimate may significantly differ from the final bill, potentially doubling. I needed my AC repaired, and on Monday, they quoted me $550-$600 and I agreed for work to begin. However, when I went to pick up my car on Wednesday, they informed me that they had "messed up on the estimate" and the bill was actually $1,100. They didn't call to inform me of the price change before beginning work. When I asked them in store about it during pickup, the lady from the back said there’s no way that he quoted me for that amount, since the part itself costs $575 (I looked it up- you can find one for $250-350). Then, they claimed that the original estimate was discarded because it was written on the back of another sheet, so now there was no proof of what I was told. So, I suggest making sure you get a written quote sent to you, before allowing them to start any work. This might give you a better chance of holding them to their estimate if any discrepancies arise. Although they worked the price down some, and the AC is now blowing cold air, I am going to give them just one star solely based on the extremely shady and bad business practice I saw from them. Based on my experience, I won't be returning, and I strongly recommend considering another repair shop.

reviews.author: Cam Man
reviews.text: Had my A/C serviced today, staff was absolutely wonderful and friendly, my car was taken care of quickly and professionally. Pricing was perfect I got phenomenal service for a very fair price. If I run into car issues again, without a doubt this will be where I come back to!

reviews.author: Melissa Lovelady
reviews.text: UPDATE: Thanksgiving day 11/24/23 We are broken down on the side of the interstate between Camden and Columbia in the car that was supposedly fixed. My first experience went really well. Camden automotive was recommended to me by a local friend. I have a 2010 Toyota Camry with about 250k miles on it. Drop off and pick up was seamless and very convenient. Good communication, friendly, and when an oversight issue came up after the fact they fixed it quickly and at no charge. Our 2nd and 3rd experience was the opposite. Took in a 2004 Honda Accord because it was leaking oil. The receipts dated 11/2/23 reflect what Camden Auto diagnosed as wrong and what we paid for repairs. Less than 70 miles later, the oil reservoir was bone dry, and the car had to be towed. The receipt dated 11/7/23 is what we were told the second time was the reason for the oil leak and when we picked it up II asked if THIS time it was fixed and he told us he didn't know and couldn't guarantee it. This was new information AFTER spending $1600 with them! Even though they failed to fix the oil leak problem the first time that left us stranded in Columbia, we were charged for the towing to bring the car back so they could 'fix' it again. We picked the car up today 11/8/23. We'll see what happens. If you are allergic to cigarettes or any of their compounds, DO NOT enter the storefront building !

reviews.author: Alina C
reviews.text: I will always take my vehicles here if I need anything checked or worked on. They are Fair and most importantly Honest. They go above and beyond in making sure that their Customers are well informed before making decisions on their vehicles. And when I needed to be towed off the side of road. They were quick to get there and efficient.

reviews.author: Jason Neely
reviews.text: They towed my truck, did the work and then called with the total. They won't tell you ahead of time and get your permission unless you specifically ask them to, which you find out after the fact. You're stuck with the bill.

reviews.author: Growing with the Hearns
reviews.text: Broke down late one afternoon while passing through South Carolina. Thankful we chose to have our truck taken to them! They diagnosed the issue same day (even though it was brought in later in the day) - and had our truck fixed the following afternoon! Very hospitable and kind people!

reviews.author: Michael Cook
reviews.text: They were efficient and cost effective. I've been to several other mechanics in town who either didn't notice or didn't care about my car's issues, but Camden Automotive and Diesel got my car running smoothely again. 10/10 will return if I have car troubles in the future.

reviews.author: Chris Artz
reviews.text: Great communication, you get what you pay for and these guys do great work. They even helped me out by towing my vehicle from my house. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sondra L
reviews.text: Don't waste your time, was given the run around called on a Friday about 2:30 to inquire when I could bring my van in for a problem. Owner said they are closed till Monday, so I said I will come by Monday and make an appointment. So 9:30 am that Monday I went by there, I told him my van was jerking and sputtering when I slowed down so I wondered if the transmission needed to be serviced, do they do that yes, BUT take it to a transmission place to have it checked, so I did. Johnson's Transmission, they test drove it very good, said the torque converter is working fine, not tranny is engine trouble so I go back to CA&D and tell them so they make an appointment for that coming Friday 8 am ,for Engine Tune up and check speed sensors... I say I can leave it for the day BUT I have to have it back by end of day. At 8 am I arrived, they took my info I told the Secretary I'm walking to the library and will wait there for it to be done. By 2:00 pm I've heard nothing so I call.. They have not even looked at it!! I said are you going to get it done today, Well if we can't I wont tear it apart where you can't drive it... 4:pm they call me come get it.. THEY DID NOTHING he said they replaced one sensor but it didn't solve the problem OKAY it takes all of 20 mins to replace a sensor and shouldn't take more than an hr to put in some spark plugs he gives me this whine and dance about how busy he is, running 3 businesses, WHY make an appointment if you are NOT going to honor it? Isn't that the point of making one? Wasted my entire day and I got nothing done to my van,....Im trying to get it ready for a trip...he suggests I should RENT a car so I can leave it a few days.. Really? I think he should NOT take APPOINTMENTS for work he has NO PLANS OF DOING if he had told me he is too busy I could have gone to another garage and actually got the work DONE! I won't be back!

reviews.author: Larry Pechal
reviews.text: I was in town for business and they new I was working on a tight time frame and they got me going again as promised and I was able to make my appointment afterwards. They are great. Andy is amazing

reviews.text: Had a dead battery in downtown and called them they came and got me cranked and went there right away and they checked out my car and installed new battery very quickly..good auto shop!!

reviews.text: Andy and his crew saved us! Our radiator cracked on a trip out of town, and they got us fixed up quickly and for a good price too!

reviews.text: They are very friendly, helpful, and professional. I feel that they don't try to upsell you or recommend repairs that aren't needed.

reviews.author: Crystal Dunning
reviews.text: They were fast and friendly and Andy and Cody were great!! Also greatly and fairly priced! Thanks y'all!
